summary: Willow implementation matches the approved specification and all declared automated, build, browser, secret-isolation, and policy checks pass.
findings: Server-only provider selection, correlated NDJSON streaming, client-executed atomic form tools, scoped persistence, retry/cancellation, and deterministic mock compatibility are implemented and covered.
residual_risks: Real OpenRouter behavior depends on the selected model's streaming and tool-call support and should receive a controlled deployment smoke test.
